objective.name: infer.recorded
objective.description: Inference provider of the real-LLM tests: forwards the request to the real provider and records the exchange.

#root.role: Forward a canonical inference request to the real provider and keep what was sent and received.

request.description: Canonical inference request; parameters.upstream_provider selects the real provider (default anthropic).

transformation_contract.morphing: A canonical request becomes the real provider answer, and the exchange becomes an entry of real_calls.
invariants: The answer returned is exactly the one of the real provider; recording never alters it.
The request is recorded as forwarded, with provider replaced by the upstream provider and upstream_provider removed from its parameters.
A provider failure is recorded then re-raised.
success: The answer is returned and one entry (request, response, usage, elapsed time or error) is appended to real_calls.
notes: Executed by the test_tools Python wrapper over a fixed in-memory shop world (test infrastructure, deterministic). It is reached through the provider case 'recorded' of /root/llm/infer.
